svg.title: L4 Detail -- DFE on AWS, controller identities
svg.desc: Three cluster controllers hold an AWS identity through EKS Pod Identity. external-dns and cert-manager write records in the private and public Route 53 zones, Karpenter reads its SQS interruption queue, and the Load Balancer Controller creates the gateway and receiver NLBs.
